packs.title: 新概念路线·原创基础篇
packs.description: 15 课原创基础训练，从日常问候走到完整句型；不含教材原文或原版音频

source.content: All Chinese and English practice statements are original Earthworm curriculum content. No textbook passages, answer keys, PDF or DOCX content, transcripts, or publisher audio are included.

courses.title: Lesson 1: Excuse Me
courses.description: 礼貌询问、确认物品与表达感谢

statements.chinese: 劳驾。
statements.english: Excuse me.

statements.chinese: 这是你的钢笔吗？
statements.english: Is this your pen?

statements.chinese: 是的，这是我的钢笔。
statements.english: Yes, this is my pen.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你。
statements.english: Thank you.

statements.chinese: 不客气。
statements.english: You're welcome.

statements.chinese: 那是你的包吗？
statements.english: Is that your bag?

statements.chinese: 不，那不是我的包。
statements.english: No, that isn't my bag.

statements.chinese: 我的包在椅子上。
statements.english: My bag is on the chair.

statements.chinese: 我找到它了。
statements.english: I found it.

statements.chinese: 太好了。
statements.english: That's great.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你的帮助。
statements.english: Thank you for your help.

courses.title: Lesson 2: Sorry, Sir
courses.description: 道歉、解释迟到与礼貌回应

statements.chinese: 对不起，先生。
statements.english: Sorry, sir.

statements.chinese: 我迟到了。
statements.english: I'm late.

statements.chinese: 没关系。
statements.english: That's all right.

statements.chinese: 发生了什么事？
statements.english: What happened?

statements.chinese: 我错过了公交车。
statements.english: I missed the bus.

statements.chinese: 你可以坐在这里。
statements.english: You can sit here.

statements.chinese: 这是你的座位吗？
statements.english: Is this your seat?

statements.chinese: 不，我的座位在窗边。
statements.english: No, my seat is by the window.

statements.chinese: 我坐错位置了。
statements.english: I took the wrong seat.

statements.chinese: 我现在就换位置。
statements.english: I'll move now.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你的理解。
statements.english: Thank you for understanding.

statements.chinese: 下次我会更仔细。
statements.english: I'll be more careful next time.

courses.title: Lesson 3: Nice to Meet You
courses.description: 自我介绍、询问姓名与初次见面

statements.chinese: 你好。
statements.english: Hello.

statements.chinese: 我叫林。
statements.english: My name is Lin.

statements.chinese: 你叫什么名字？
statements.english: What's your name?

statements.chinese: 我叫安娜。
statements.english: My name is Anna.

statements.chinese: 很高兴认识你。
statements.english: Nice to meet you.

statements.chinese: 我也很高兴认识你。
statements.english: Nice to meet you, too.

statements.chinese: 你来自哪里？
statements.english: Where are you from?

statements.chinese: 我来自东京。
statements.english: I'm from Tokyo.

statements.chinese: 你住在这里吗？
statements.english: Do you live here?

statements.chinese: 是的，我住在附近。
statements.english: Yes, I live nearby.

statements.chinese: 欢迎来到我们的班级。
statements.english: Welcome to our class.

statements.chinese: 我很高兴来到这里。
statements.english: I'm happy to be here.

courses.title: Lesson 4: Are You a Teacher?
courses.description: 询问职业、工作地点与日常职责

statements.chinese: 你是老师吗？
statements.english: Are you a teacher?

statements.chinese: 是的，我是一名英语老师。
statements.english: Yes, I'm an English teacher.

statements.chinese: 你在哪里工作？
statements.english: Where do you work?

statements.chinese: 我在附近的一所学校工作。
statements.english: I work at a school nearby.

statements.chinese: 你教儿童吗？
statements.english: Do you teach children?

statements.chinese: 是的，我教一个小班。
statements.english: Yes, I teach a small class.

statements.chinese: 你的工作有趣吗？
statements.english: Is your job interesting?

statements.chinese: 是的，我每天都学到新东西。
statements.english: Yes, I learn something new every day.

statements.chinese: 你什么时候开始工作？
statements.english: When do you start work?

statements.chinese: 我八点开始工作。
statements.english: I start work at eight.

statements.chinese: 你喜欢你的学生吗？
statements.english: Do you like your students?

statements.chinese: 是的，他们很友善，也很努力。
statements.english: Yes, they're kind and hardworking.

courses.title: Lesson 5: How Are You Today?
courses.description: 问候、描述感受与给出简单建议

statements.chinese: 你今天好吗？
statements.english: How are you today?

statements.chinese: 我很好，谢谢。
statements.english: I'm fine, thank you.

statements.chinese: 你看起来有点累。
statements.english: You look a little tired.

statements.chinese: 我昨晚睡得不好。
statements.english: I didn't sleep well last night.

statements.chinese: 你需要休息。
statements.english: You need some rest.

statements.chinese: 我先喝点水。
statements.english: I'll drink some water first.

statements.chinese: 你头疼吗？
statements.english: Do you have a headache?

statements.chinese: 不，我只是有点困。
statements.english: No, I'm just a little sleepy.

statements.chinese: 午饭后休息一下吧。
statements.english: Take a short break after lunch.

statements.chinese: 这是个好主意。
statements.english: That's a good idea.

statements.chinese: 希望你很快感觉好一些。
statements.english: I hope you feel better soon.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你的关心。
statements.english: Thank you for caring.

courses.title: 基础 06 · 计划未来
courses.description: will、计划和预测

statements.chinese: 我明天会检查我的笔记本。
statements.english: I will check my notebook tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 你今晚会阅读这条消息。
statements.english: You will read this message this evening.

statements.chinese: 他下周一会携带他的蓝色包。
statements.english: He will carry his blue bag next Monday.

statements.chinese: 她今天晚些时候会打开窗户。
statements.english: She will open the window later today.

statements.chinese: 我们本周五会打扫房间。
statements.english: We will clean the room this Friday.

statements.chinese: 他们明天早晨会准备早餐。
statements.english: They will prepare breakfast tomorrow morning.

statements.chinese: 我妹妹下周末会选择一条红裙子。
statements.english: My sister will choose a red dress next weekend.

statements.chinese: 我们的老师明天会解释新单词。
statements.english: Our teacher will explain the new words tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 汤姆下周日会清洗汽车。
statements.english: Tom will wash the car next Sunday.

statements.chinese: 孩子们明天下午会画一幅画。
statements.english: The children will draw a picture tomorrow afternoon.

statements.chinese: 我的父母下个月会拜访我们的祖父母。
statements.english: My parents will visit our grandparents next month.

statements.chinese: 公交车十分钟后会到达市中心。
statements.english: The bus will reach the city center in ten minutes.

courses.title: 基础 07 · 提出问题
courses.description: 一般疑问句和信息确认

statements.chinese: 我每天早晨检查我的笔记本吗？
statements.english: Do I check my notebook every morning?

statements.chinese: 你午饭后阅读这条消息吗？
statements.english: Do you read this message after lunch?

statements.chinese: 他每周一携带他的蓝色包吗？
statements.english: Does he carry his blue bag every Monday?

statements.chinese: 她每天下午打开窗户吗？
statements.english: Does she open the window every afternoon?

statements.chinese: 我们每周五打扫房间吗？
statements.english: Do we clean the room every Friday?

statements.chinese: 他们七点准备早餐吗？
statements.english: Do they prepare breakfast at seven?

statements.chinese: 我妹妹周末选择一条红裙子吗？
statements.english: Does my sister choose a red dress on weekends?

statements.chinese: 我们的老师每天解释新单词吗？
statements.english: Does our teacher explain the new words every day?

statements.chinese: 汤姆每周日清洗汽车吗？
statements.english: Does Tom wash the car on Sundays?

statements.chinese: 孩子们放学后画一幅画吗？
statements.english: Do the children draw a picture after school?

statements.chinese: 我的父母每个月拜访我们的祖父母吗？
statements.english: Do my parents visit our grandparents every month?

statements.chinese: 公交车每十分钟到达市中心吗？
statements.english: Does the bus reach the city center every ten minutes?

courses.title: 基础 08 · 能力与建议
courses.description: can、should 和礼貌建议

statements.chinese: 我应该在家检查我的笔记本。
statements.english: I should check my notebook at home.

statements.chinese: 你应该在教室里阅读这条消息。
statements.english: You should read this message in the classroom.

statements.chinese: 他应该在车站携带他的蓝色包。
statements.english: He should carry his blue bag at the station.

statements.chinese: 她应该在办公室打开窗户。
statements.english: She should open the window in the office.

statements.chinese: 我们应该在学校打扫房间。
statements.english: We should clean the room at school.

statements.chinese: 他们应该在厨房准备早餐。
statements.english: They should prepare breakfast in the kitchen.

statements.chinese: 我妹妹应该在商店选择一条红裙子。
statements.english: My sister should choose a red dress at the shop.

statements.chinese: 我们的老师应该在课堂上解释新单词。
statements.english: Our teacher should explain the new words in class.

statements.chinese: 汤姆应该在房子外面清洗汽车。
statements.english: Tom should wash the car outside the house.

statements.chinese: 孩子们应该在花园里画一幅画。
statements.english: The children should draw a picture in the garden.

statements.chinese: 我的父母应该在村里拜访我们的祖父母。
statements.english: My parents should visit our grandparents in the village.

statements.chinese: 公交车应该在银行附近到达市中心。
statements.english: The bus should reach the city center near the bank.

courses.title: 基础 09 · 比较与选择
courses.description: 比较级和选择理由

statements.chinese: 我比另一位学习者更有准备。
statements.english: I am more ready than another learner.

statements.chinese: 你比另一位学习者更仔细。
statements.english: You are more careful than another learner.

statements.chinese: 他比他的同学更早。
statements.english: He is earlier than his classmate.

statements.chinese: 她比她的队友更忙。
statements.english: She is busier than her teammate.

statements.chinese: 我们比另一个小组更安静。
statements.english: We are quieter than the other group.

statements.chinese: 他们比另一个小组更饿。
statements.english: They are hungrier than the other group.

statements.chinese: 我妹妹比另一位店员更开心。
statements.english: My sister is happier than the other assistant.

statements.chinese: 我们的老师比另一位老师更有耐心。
statements.english: Our teacher is more patient than the other teacher.

statements.chinese: 汤姆比他哥哥更累。
statements.english: Tom is more tired than his brother.

statements.chinese: 孩子们比另一个班的学生更有创意。
statements.english: The children are more creative than the other class.

statements.chinese: 我的父母比邻居一家更亲切。
statements.english: My parents are kinder than the neighboring family.

statements.chinese: 公交车比本地火车更快。
statements.english: The bus is faster than the local train.

courses.title: 基础 10 · 地点与数量
courses.description: there be、位置和数量表达

statements.chinese: 在家有一本笔记本。
statements.english: There is a notebook at home.

statements.chinese: 在教室里有一条消息。
statements.english: There is a message in the classroom.

statements.chinese: 在车站有一个蓝色包。
statements.english: There is a blue bag at the station.

statements.chinese: 在办公室有一扇开着的窗户。
statements.english: There is an open window in the office.

statements.chinese: 在学校有一间干净的房间。
statements.english: There is a clean room at school.

statements.chinese: 在厨房有一份热早餐。
statements.english: There is a warm breakfast in the kitchen.

statements.chinese: 在商店有一条红裙子。
statements.english: There is a red dress at the shop.

statements.chinese: 在课堂上有一个有用的例子。
statements.english: There is a useful example in class.

statements.chinese: 在房子外面有一辆干净的汽车。
statements.english: There is a clean car outside the house.

statements.chinese: 在花园里有一幅彩色的画。
statements.english: There is a colorful picture in the garden.

statements.chinese: 在村里有一张全家福。
statements.english: There is a family photo in the village.

statements.chinese: 在银行附近有一个公交站。
statements.english: There is a bus stop near the bank.

courses.title: 基础 11 · 经验与结果
courses.description: 现在完成时和经历表达

statements.chinese: 我以前检查过我的笔记本。
statements.english: I have checked my notebook before.

statements.chinese: 你以前阅读过这条消息。
statements.english: You have read this message before.

statements.chinese: 他以前携带过他的蓝色包。
statements.english: He has carried his blue bag before.

statements.chinese: 她以前打开过窗户。
statements.english: She has opened the window before.

statements.chinese: 我们以前打扫过房间。
statements.english: We have cleaned the room before.

statements.chinese: 他们以前准备过早餐。
statements.english: They have prepared breakfast before.

statements.chinese: 我妹妹以前选择过一条红裙子。
statements.english: My sister has chosen a red dress before.

statements.chinese: 我们的老师以前解释过新单词。
statements.english: Our teacher has explained the new words before.

statements.chinese: 汤姆以前清洗过汽车。
statements.english: Tom has washed the car before.

statements.chinese: 孩子们以前画过一幅画。
statements.english: The children have drawn a picture before.

statements.chinese: 我的父母以前拜访过我们的祖父母。
statements.english: My parents have visited our grandparents before.

statements.chinese: 公交车以前到达过市中心。
statements.english: The bus has reached the city center before.

courses.title: 基础 12 · 条件与结果
courses.description: 真实条件句和结果预测

statements.chinese: 如果我检查我的笔记本，我会很有准备。
statements.english: If I check my notebook, I will be ready.

statements.chinese: 如果你阅读这条消息，你会很仔细。
statements.english: If you read this message, you will be careful.

statements.chinese: 如果他携带他的蓝色包，他会很早。
statements.english: If he carries his blue bag, he will be early.

statements.chinese: 如果她打开窗户，她会很忙。
statements.english: If she opens the window, she will be busy.

statements.chinese: 如果我们打扫房间，我们会很安静。
statements.english: If we clean the room, we will be quiet.

statements.chinese: 如果他们准备早餐，他们会很饿。
statements.english: If they prepare breakfast, they will be hungry.

statements.chinese: 如果我妹妹选择一条红裙子，她会很开心。
statements.english: If my sister chooses a red dress, she will be happy.

statements.chinese: 如果我们的老师解释新单词，她会很有耐心。
statements.english: If our teacher explains the new words, she will be patient.

statements.chinese: 如果汤姆清洗汽车，他会很累。
statements.english: If Tom washes the car, he will be tired.

statements.chinese: 如果孩子们画一幅画，他们会很有创意。
statements.english: If the children draw a picture, they will be creative.

statements.chinese: 如果我的父母拜访我们的祖父母，他们会很亲切。
statements.english: If my parents visit our grandparents, they will be kind.

statements.chinese: 如果公交车到达市中心，它会很快。
statements.english: If the bus reaches the city center, it will be fast.

courses.title: 基础 13 · 动作与承受者
courses.description: 被动语态和过程描述

statements.chinese: 昨天，我的笔记本由我检查。
statements.english: My notebook was checked by me yesterday.

statements.chinese: 昨晚，这条消息由你阅读。
statements.english: This message was read by you last night.

statements.chinese: 昨天早晨，他的蓝色包由他携带。
statements.english: His blue bag was carried by him yesterday morning.

statements.chinese: 一小时前，窗户由她打开。
statements.english: The window was opened by her an hour ago.

statements.chinese: 上周五，房间由我们打扫。
statements.english: The room was cleaned by us last Friday.

statements.chinese: 今天早晨，早餐由他们准备。
statements.english: Breakfast was prepared by them this morning.

statements.chinese: 上周末，一条红裙子由我妹妹选择。
statements.english: A red dress was chosen by my sister last weekend.

statements.chinese: 昨天，新单词由我们的老师解释。
statements.english: The new words were explained by our teacher yesterday.

statements.chinese: 上周日，汽车由汤姆清洗。
statements.english: The car was washed by Tom last Sunday.

statements.chinese: 昨天下午，一幅画由孩子们画。
statements.english: A picture was drawn by the children yesterday afternoon.

statements.chinese: 上个月，我们的祖父母由我的父母拜访。
statements.english: Our grandparents were visited by my parents last month.

statements.chinese: 十分钟前，市中心由公交车到达。
statements.english: The city center was reached by the bus ten minutes ago.

statements.english: The friend who checks my notebook is ready.

statements.chinese: 阅读这条消息的同学很仔细。

statements.chinese: 打开窗户的老师很忙。

statements.chinese: 打扫房间的学生很安静。
statements.english: The student who cleans the room is quiet.

statements.chinese: 准备早餐的厨师很饿。
statements.english: The cook who prepares breakfast is hungry.

statements.chinese: 选择一条红裙子的店员很开心。
statements.english: The assistant who chooses a red dress is happy.

statements.chinese: 解释新单词的老师很有耐心。
statements.english: The teacher who explains the new words is patient.

statements.chinese: 清洗汽车的邻居很累。
statements.english: The neighbor who washes the car is tired.

statements.chinese: 画一幅画的画家很有创意。
statements.english: The artist who draws a picture is creative.

statements.chinese: 拜访我们的祖父母的农民很亲切。
statements.english: The farmer who visits our grandparents is kind.

statements.chinese: 到达市中心的乘客很快。
statements.english: The passenger who reaches the city center is fast.

statements.english: Although she was busy, she opened the window.

statements.chinese: 虽然我们很安静，但我们还是打扫了房间。
statements.english: Although we were quiet, we cleaned the room.

statements.chinese: 虽然他们很饿，但他们还是准备了早餐。
statements.english: Although they were hungry, they prepared breakfast.

statements.chinese: 虽然我妹妹很开心，但她还是选择了一条红裙子。
statements.english: Although my sister was happy, she chose a red dress.

statements.chinese: 虽然我们的老师很有耐心，但她还是解释了新单词。
statements.english: Although our teacher was patient, she explained the new words.

statements.chinese: 虽然汤姆很累，但他还是清洗了汽车。
statements.english: Although Tom was tired, he washed the car.

statements.chinese: 虽然孩子们很有创意，但他们还是画了一幅画。
statements.english: Although the children were creative, they drew a picture.

statements.chinese: 虽然我的父母很亲切，但他们还是拜访了我们的祖父母。
statements.english: Although my parents were kind, they visited our grandparents.

courses.title: 进阶 01 · 状态与身份
courses.description: be 动词、身份和状态描述

statements.chinese: 我很灵活。
statements.english: I am flexible.

statements.chinese: 你很高效。
statements.english: You are efficient.

statements.chinese: 米娅很独立。
statements.english: Mia is independent.

statements.chinese: 丹尼尔很熟练。
statements.english: Daniel is skillful.

statements.chinese: 我们很客观。
statements.english: We are objective.

statements.chinese: 他们很可靠。
statements.english: They are reliable.

statements.chinese: 我们团队很全面。
statements.english: Our team is thorough.

statements.chinese: 店主很友好。
